race.comment: EMPHATIQUE (6) has gone close to winning a race this prep, and she has been holding her form strongly despite being in work for some time. She drops 2.5kg from her last start, and this represents another good chance for her to finally break through. CASSIA COUNTY (5) has had her racing well spaced, and she needed the run when resuming here 18 days ago. She has the pole position, and it is encouraging to see her have another run reasonably soon after her fresh fourth. Each way value for us. COOL ZUMBELINA (2) has changed stables since finishing second on debut at Tamworth as a juvenile in April. He has been gelded, won a trial, and is it only a nasty gate that would prevent him from a top 3 finish. Watch for market confidence. Something for the Multiples: WILD LASS (12)
